operatorProperties.code:
def process(load_f_sheet) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = load_f_sheet
    
    # Check CBX3 presence
    cbx3_mask = df['Gene'] == 'CBX3'
    cbx3_rows = df[cbx3_mask]
    non_cbx3_rows = df[~cbx3_mask]
    
    print(f"CBX3 rows: {len(cbx3_rows)}")
    print(f"Non-CBX3 rows: {len(non_cbx3_rows)}")
    print(f"CBX3 FDR.phos values: {cbx3_rows['FDR.phos'].values}")
    
    avg_fdr_cbx3 = cbx3_rows['FDR.phos'].mean()
    avg_fdr_rest = non_cbx3_rows['FDR.phos'].mean()
    diff = avg_fdr_cbx3 - avg_fdr_rest
    
    return pd.DataFrame({
        'avg_fdr_cbx3': [avg_fdr_cbx3],
        'avg_fdr_rest': [avg_fdr_rest],
        'difference': [diff],
        'difference_rounded': [round(diff, 9)]
    })

operatorProperties.code:
def process(load_f_sheet):
    df = load_f_sheet
    cbx3 = df[df['Gene'] == 'CBX3']['FDR.phos']
    rest = df[df['Gene'] != 'CBX3']['FDR.phos']
    avg_cbx3 = cbx3.mean()
    avg_rest = rest.mean()
    diff = avg_cbx3 - avg_rest
    diff_rounded = round(diff, 9)
    return pd.DataFrame({
        'avg_fdr_cbx3': [avg_cbx3],
        'avg_fdr_rest': [avg_rest],
        'difference': [diff],
        'difference_rounded': [diff_rounded],
        'difference_str': [f"{diff:.9f}"]
    })

operatorProperties.code:
def process(load_f_sheet):
    df = load_f_sheet
    cbx3 = df[df['Gene'] == 'CBX3']['FDR.phos']
    rest = df[df['Gene'] != 'CBX3']['FDR.phos']
    avg_cbx3 = cbx3.mean()
    avg_rest = rest.mean()
    diff = avg_cbx3 - avg_rest
    result = round(diff, 9)
    return pd.DataFrame({
        'cbx3_count': [len(cbx3)],
        'rest_count': [len(rest)],
        'avg_fdr_cbx3': [avg_cbx3],
        'avg_fdr_rest': [avg_rest],
        'difference': [diff],
        'rounded_9dp': [result],
        'rounded_9dp_str': [f"{result:.9f}"]
    })
